text: Encourage him in imaginative play; for example, give him a spoon so he can pretend to feed his stuffed toy, and take turns in pretending. This develops his communication skills and symbolic thinking.

review_defects.why: The Arabic explicitly says 'exchange roles' (تبادلا الأدوار), which is a specific type of turn-taking where each person takes on a different role. The translation generalizes to 'take turns in pretending', losing the nuance of role exchange.
